angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 740,921 km at 646.18 pc = 0.02 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 1.5476 +/- 0.0117 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 646.18 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.065 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Lissauer et al. 2013, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...770..131L/abstract): 740,921 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.961 +/- 0.025 solar masses from Lissauer et al. 2013, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...770..131L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5663 +/- 55 K from Lissauer et al. 2013, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...770..131L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lissauer et al. 2013, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...770..131L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-11.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.366, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, Kepler-11: main object type Er*, Eruptive Variable
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-11 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.05 dex, from Fulton & Petigura 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..264F/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-11 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.1202, from Gajdoš et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019RAA....19...41G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-11 (pscomppars): age 8.5 Gyr, from Lissauer et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...770..131L/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-11 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.4 km/s, from Lissauer et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011Natur.470...53L/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
